text:
maria: Need a concise benchmark narrative for next Wed launch. Deliverables: 1 short post, 3-chart mini-deck, 20-min webinar. Focus = latency vs token cost + inbound routing.
emily: Targeting platform engs first, then a simplified SMB variant?
raj: Yes platform-first. include p95/p99 and batching/quant tradeoffs.
josh: Quick baselines to confirm: median ~90ms, p95 ~240ms, p99 ~480ms; cost ~ $0.24/1k tokens. I'll validate overnight.
olga: I'll prepare GA events and add hidden reg fields for routing: priority_latency / priority_cost.
benchbot: Figma draft: https://figma.com/file/redwood/bench-mini (page: "latency-cost-3panel").
maria: Owners & ETA 48h: emily = post + webinar script, raj = charts, josh = numbers + appendix, olga = tracking + routing.
emily: I'll draft copy with a worked example (500-token response calc).
raj: Chart plan: 1) latency vs $/1k scatter, 2) hosted vs dedicated unit cost waterfall, 3) p99 heatmap by seq length.
josh: Note: publish test config with any p99 claims. add a small footnote on quant quality.
maria: Good. We'll A/B test two short headlines on reg page: platform tone vs product tone. Ping #eng-runtime for infra snapshot at publish.
olga: Funnel rules: route high-latency priority + p99>300ms -> dedicated-sales; top spend -> cost-review; else nurture.
emily: Dry-run in 48h.
raj: Uploads to figma by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Thanks team :rocket:
